user.description: Connect to the cPanel account that hosts your Dynamic DNS name. Create an API token in cPanel under Security, Manage API Tokens.

data_description.host: The hostname you use to log in to cPanel, for example server.example.com.
data_description.domain: The name Home Assistant is reached at, for example home.example.com. AutoSSL issues the certificate for it.
data_description.dynamic_dns: Point this name at your public IP using cPanel Dynamic DNS. The record is created if it does not exist and updated every five minutes.

reauth_confirm.description: cPanel rejected the API token for {username} on {host}. Enter a new one.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Already configured. Only a single configuration possible.

data_description.dynamic_dns: Keep the Dynamic DNS record pointed at your public IP.

ssl_not_configured.title: Home Assistant is not serving HTTPS
